As we can see from the picture above, in $△BAD$ we have $m∠BAD={90}^{∘},$ $AB=10,$ and $AD=BC=6\sqrt{2}.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}|\overset{\to }{BD}| & =BD \\  & =\sqrt{A{B}^{2}+A{D}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{10}^{2}+(6\sqrt{2})^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{100+72} \\  & =\sqrt{172} \\  & =2\sqrt{43}.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, $|\overset{\to }{BD}|=2\sqrt{43}.$
